basis.en: W15-13: the date of the newest release heading of CHANGELOG.md when the bake runs; committed, never a wall-clock date, never earlier than the date a finding was raised. Here: the heading of release 1.00.000, 2026-10-22.
basis.es: W15-13: la fecha del encabezado de versión más reciente de CHANGELOG.md cuando corre el bake; versionada, nunca una fecha del reloj, nunca anterior a la fecha de registro de un hallazgo. Aquí: el encabezado de la versión 1.00.000, 2026-10-22.

exposure_band_cuts.label: convention
exposure_band_cuts.basis: share of the stated balance at least 25 percent is band 4, 10 percent 3, 2 percent 2, below that 1; dossier 06 B.3 fixes no cut-offs (item 30 of the UNVERIFIED list; A D2 3.2, W15-3)

regulatory_use_grades.label: convention
regulatory_use_grades.basis: W15-3: graded 4 where the output is itself the reported or binding figure, 3 where it is a parameter or a back-test that feeds one, 2 for compliance monitoring, 1 for none; literal 4 whenever the output feeds capital, provisioning or reporting; the literal grade is never below the graded one (A D2 3.2)

complexity_rounding.label: convention
complexity_rounding.basis: 06 l.567: C is the mean of the factor scores; the rounding is not in the text, half up is used and the maximum is the alternative reading (A D2 3.3)

frequency.label: convention
frequency.basis: 06 B.8 l.636-640: Tier 1 annual review, full revalidation every 3 years, quarterly monitoring; Tier 2 annual, 3 years, semi-annual; Tier 3 every 2 years with annual monitoring; Tier 4 an attestation every 3 years; configurable, and the ECB minimums of 12 and 36 months replace it for the profile `ecb` (item 30)

title.en: The tier rubric has no materiality term for fan-out
title.es: La rúbrica de niveles no tiene un término de materialidad por dependencia

description.en: The engine and C22's test sizing reach every case, yet C22 keeps the tier its inputs give (Tier 4): the rubric counts feeders in complexity and has no term for fan-out in materiality (A D2 3.5 item 3).
description.es: El motor y el dimensionamiento de pruebas de C22 alcanzan a todos los casos, pero C22 conserva el nivel que dan sus insumos (Nivel 4): la rúbrica cuenta alimentadores en la complejidad y no tiene un término de dependencia en la materialidad (A D2 3.5, punto 3).

title.en: Independence of the validator is not established
title.es: La independencia del validador no está establecida

description.en: The pipeline (developer) and the engine (validator) are built in the same programme, so the separation of the first and second line is a convention, not a fact (A D1 A31).
description.es: El pipeline (desarrollador) y el motor (validador) se construyen en el mismo programa, por lo que la separación entre primera y segunda línea es una convención y no un hecho (A D1 A31).
